title: Chapter 2899 - 158: Witch Vulture God (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 2899: Chapter 158: Witch Vulture God (Part 2)

Mo Hua’s words clearly touched the Witch Vulture God’s "reverse scale".

"Blaspheming the name of the Divine Lord, you’re courting death!"

The Witch Vulture God’s gaze was sharp, and he roared fiercely, his powerful telekinesis surging, with divine power flowing throughout his body.

On his wings, the aura of decay reignited, and the entire god emanated a terrifying majesty that mortal beings could not gaze upon directly.

The Wujiu Great God assumed a cold and stern posture and said, "Today, I will make you pay the price, make you understand..."

Mo Hua rushed up and punched, and the Witch Vulture God was immediately knocked down.

"What are you pretending to be a big-tailed wolf in front of me?" Mo Hua said displeasedly.

The Witch Vulture God was obviously unconvinced, still wanting to struggle, still wanting to say something.

Mo Hua sat on him, plucked his wings, pressed his head to the ground, raised his small fist, as big as a clay pot, and punched him until he was bruised and swollen.

While hitting, Mo Hua muttered:

"You’re still pretending, still pretending..."

The Witch Vulture God was thoroughly subdued, no longer daring to act strong, not caring about the dignity of a god, feeling helpless inside, and also nearly vomiting blood from anger...

The Law of the Great Dao, sometimes really doesn’t make any sense.

This bird place of the Great Wilderness, either the Divine Way is declining, with a whole basket of weaklings like earth chickens and clay dogs, or the goat-headed snake demons with weak divine power dare to claim to be gods.

Or suddenly, heaven and earth are turned upside down, a "Little Demon God" jumps out, outside the Five Elements of heaven and earth, with divine skills so powerful they are incomprehensible, even capable of swallowing deities.

Doesn’t the Heavenly Dao see, to make some strength "balance" for this place of the Great Wilderness?

Either they are unbelievably weak, or they are incomprehensibly strong.

Since the Divine Lord was gone, the Wujiu Great God, who had been "invincible" for thousands of years, really felt exasperated.

But there’s no choice, being a god means being able to stretch and shrink.

In front of mortal beings, you must be sacred and majestic, one word as heavy as nine cauldrons.

In front of even stronger divine monsters, you must humble yourself, swallow your pride.

Wujiu Great God immediately said, "Little Divine Monarch, I... I was wrong..."

Mo Hua withdrew his fists, asking, "Really know your wrongs?"

The Witch Vulture God nodded, not daring not to admit his mistake.

Mo Hua also nodded, temporarily letting the Witch Vulture God off, "Alright, then let me ask you, speak honestly..."

"Yes." The Witch Vulture God said honestly.

Mo Hua asked, "Have you really seen the Master of the Great Wilderness?"

The Wujiu Great God looked at Mo Hua, "You, Little Divine Monarch, are the Master of the Great Wilderness."

Mo Hua said coldly, "Not me, this ’Master of the Great Wilderness’, but the one before, don’t try to fool me."

The Wujiu Great God was helpless and could only sigh, "I’ve seen them."

"How many years ago?" Mo Hua asked.

The Wujiu Great God shook his head; seeing Mo Hua’s displeasure, he quickly added:

"I really can’t remember, deities don’t know the years, and also receive tributes. The incense is intermittent according to the strength of belief, so I am sometimes clear-headed, sometimes confused. I can’t remember the exact years, only roughly knowing that thousands of years ago, I met the Divine Lord..."

Mo Hua asked again, "What did the Divine Lord look like?"

"This..." The Wujiu Great God hesitated and said, "Unlike us new gods, the Divine Lord is a real ’Ancient God’, with a long history, a deeply profound origin, countless incarnations, and a thousand changeable divine forms. What I saw was just one of the many divine forms... I only roughly remember, the Divine Lord had a human body with ram horns, a face of white bone, and an aura frighteningly strong..."

In the Wildland, the Wujiu Great God is one of the only "ancient" deities left.

But in front of the Master of the Great Wilderness, he can only refer to himself as a "newcomer", as if he were just a young "junior".

The vast disparity in years between gods and humans is evident at a glance.

What the Wujiu Great God described about the Divine Lord’s appearance is indeed very similar to the image of the white bone Evil God Mo Hua saw at the Qian Learning State Boundary.

"Then... why did the Divine Lord of the Great Wilderness suddenly disappear from the history of the Great Wilderness?" Mo Hua curiously asked.

This question had puzzled him for a long time.

The Wujiu Great God frowned, evidently not very certain either, "The Divine Lord is an ’Ancient God’, and many secrets are not something deities like me can explore, but indeed, when the Divine Lord suddenly disappeared, there were many strange things..."

Mo Hua pursued, "What was strange?"

The Wujiu Great God’s voice was solemn, "I... can’t quite say..."

Mo Hua raised his fist, his gaze unfriendly.

The Wujiu Great God quickly said, "It’s not that I don’t want to say, but rather..."

With a bitter expression, the Wujiu Great God continued, "There are some secrets on the Divine Way that, if it’s vague and hard to articulate, it means that there are some unknowable existences concealing it, preventing you from knowing. I am merely a tribal god with some understanding of the Dao, not one of those truly ancient deities, so some things, I have no ability to probe..."

Mo Hua frowned slightly, feeling that what he said made sense.

Sometimes the heavenly secrets are hidden, and it’s impossible to speak of them, or else it would indeed incur great misfortune.

In the face of a true disaster, even deities may not be safe.

"Then the Divine Lord... according to your ’speculation’..."

Mo Hua emphasized the word "speculation" heavily, "could have disappeared for what reason?"

This was a very sensitive question.

The Wujiu Great God thought for a moment, then slowly said:

"Through these ages, I often pondered this..."

"The Divine Lord might have been sealed in origin by some great being’s means."

"Or perhaps was heavily injured by some great enemy and fell into slumber..."

"Or even was erased by some unknowably powerful existence, transforming from ’life’ to ’death’..."

"Of course, these are just my speculations."

"Looking at matters of the Divine Way from outside it seems illusory, from inside, perilous, and anything might happen..."

Mo Hua nodded, no longer pressing further.
